title: "Let's Do 9.91": How a $600M Fund Set Returns, Feds Say

lines.say: More than six hundred million dollars from over two thousand investors. Prosecutors say the monthly return was picked by text.
lines.show: $600M+ from over 2,000 investors. Prosecutors say the monthly return was picked by text.

lines.say: An employee texts: aggressive fund, ten point oh one percent, does this sound right? Later, prosecutors say, co-founder Phillip Williams replies: let's do nine point nine one, bumped it up a bit.
lines.show: An employee texts: "Aggressive fund 10.01% / Does this sound right?" Later, prosecutors say, co-founder Phillip Williams replies: "… Let's do 9.91 bumped it up a bit"

scene.src: Criminal complaint, U.S. v. Williams & Johnson (S.D.N.Y., Nov 17, 2026) — allegations

lines.say: On November eighteenth, two of its co-founders were arrested. They're charged, not convicted.
lines.show: On November 18, two of its co-founders were arrested. They're charged, not convicted.

lines.say: Would you have trusted six percent a month?
lines.show: Would you have trusted 6% a month?
